reviews.text: We’ve been using AJ Paws for over 3 years with our dog, Jack, and he absolutely loves it! Juliana and the girls are so sweet, caring, and amazing with him. We couldn’t be happier with their service. Highly recommend AJ Paws! ❤️🐾

This place broke my heart when they refused to groom my baby because he's over 12 years old.
I have never heard of this in my life. Many groomer take my baby in with no problems but because I don't drive and this is close to me, I decided to call to book an appointment. My dog deserves to get a bath and a hair cut ... He's a healthy and vibrant dog who just got discriminated for his age. I'm furious and heart broken. My baby deserves better. I don't care to hear your explanation that you will post here to excuse your behavior. It's unacceptable. If other groomers can do this why can't you?
Disgusting.
Simply the best.

Absolutely excellent experience! 🐾✨ The bath and grooming were done with so much care and attention to detail. My pet came back clean, fluffy, smelling amazing, and looking adorable! 💕 You can truly tell they care about the pets and treat them with love. Highly recommend this pet shop! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Amazing place, all of them are great with the dogs and very loving. Great customer service and grooming as well. The girls are the best

We randomly met one of the owners’ husband on the subway last year, and that’s how we found out about AJ Spaw. I decided to give it a try, and we’ve been coming back ever since. The service is efficient and friendly, and the online booking system is really convenient. They always make my dog look so fluffy and cute. :)) I highly recommend AJ Spaw!
Extremely great place competitive prices. The girls there are top notch. Very busy, very hard to get an appointment. Book plenty in advance.
Best salon. Always a beautiful and safe groom.

AJ Spaw is fantastic! I took my Samoyed girl for the first time and the groom was perfect, customer service is amazing and the price is very fair. Definitely recommending to all my friends with dogs - worth the drive!
Very good service. My dog doesn't usually like to get her nails done but this place is so professional they do it clean, right and fast so my dog like it! I recommend!

Best pet grooming in Toronto. Excellent service, they are super careful and caring. If you are Brazilian and looking for a pet grooming service, this is the ideal place. They offer service in Portuguese or English, and the service is just like we're used to in Brazil. Worth every penny. Impeccable service.
Great service and amazing team! Very professional, friendly, and caring with the pets. Highly recommend this grooming store!
The AJ Spaw team really loves dogs, it’s clear to see in every detail
They’re always so kind. We absolutely love AJ Spaw!
The care and kindness they have with our pets is unmatched !
Excellent, I recommend them. A very well-organized and safe company for our pets.
This is the best place!! Very professional and friendly, no doubt that the work is done by people who care a lot about animals and their well being. Congratulations!!
Best pet spa in the GTA, hands down 👏 …
Do NOT take your dog here. His eyes were damaged during the grooming and they gave him eyedrops without our consent. They continued with the grooming and even posted him on their IG account!!
Walked in and got my baby’s nails trimmed! They’re so quick and caring!
Sydney is looking fresh and happy after her first bath with AJ Spaw!

I can’t say enough good things about AJ Spaw! They take such great care of my dog Sandee and always make her look beautiful. The staff are kind, professional, and clearly love what they do. My pup always comes home happy, clean, and smelling amazing. It’s such a relief knowing she’s in good hands. Highly recommend AJ Spaw to any pet owner looking for quality grooming and a team that truly cares.
My cockapoo is a rescue so scared of strangers. They handled him with patience and kindness while grooming. We will be a regular!
First timers today. Very pleased. Clean and friendly environment. My pup was happy and is well groomed. Recommend

We took our little pup here and it was a great experience, his first place took an hour and 30 minutes it was a fast trim!
AJ took over 4 hours and said they wanted to take their time as it’s his first trim with them! He was desperate to leave the first place and AJ he was so relaxed!

The staff are great and the cut was great he looks so handsome with his fresh trim!

Before and after photos below! Amazing job team can’t wait for Obi next appointment 💃

For the last 25 years, I have had dogs (standard poodle, now Havanese) that need grooming several times a year. Hands down, this is the best groomer I have been to in the GTA and there is street parking out front or a subway close by.
But heads up, I now book my next appointment months out right after each grooming (they are busy for a reason) to ensure that I don't have to go anywhere else.
Comments from a picky retired Quality Engineer.
Go here, thank me later 😁

I always wanted to try this place, lots of recommendations from other dog owners, and I needed my dog’s nails trimmed. I walked-in and they were able to take him right away. He is a bit nervous and they helped make him feel less anxious …

We LOVE AJ Spaw!! They really take the time to care for , and pamper your dog while they are there. The experience is exceptional. They will go above and beyond with every “furry friend” to ensure everyone is happy. They have added services …

THANK YOUUUU💖

We’ve been trying different pet grooming in the neighbourhood but AJ spas is a …
Did an amazing job and the people that work there are very patient.  Highly recommend if your dog gets scared during grooming.
They are perfect, punctual, nice, reasonable price and professional grooming!
